summary: Reproduced that the exported producer types cannot decode a mixed unsalted/salted BlockStored stream without either dropping cache_salt or rejecting a valid event. Added separate decoder-side BlockStoredView and KVEventBatchView types, preserving the existing producer structs and exact 7/8-element wire shapes, with documentation and a failing-before/passing-after regression for absent and nontrivial salts.

tests.what_was_measured: Before the change, verified the actual checkout emitted 7-element unsalted and 8-element salted BlockStored arrays; KVEventBatch dropped metadata, BlockStoredWithMetadata rejected the unsalted event, and their union was invalid.
All applicable formatting, lint, spelling, repository policy, and test-registry hooks passed.

16 tests and 22 subtests passed, including a mixed batch made from the real producer structs, unchanged 7/8-element wire shapes, and recovery of None plus a Unicode/control-character salt through KVEventBatchView.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and fix are confined to msgspec CPU serialization types; no model, tensor operation, or accelerator path is involved. No unrelated GPU smoke was used as evidence.

remaining_limitations: No live model server was launched and no ZMQ transport test was run. The regression exercises the exact msgpack payload produced by the checked-in BlockStored, BlockStoredWithMetadata, and KVEventBatch implementations, which is the wire-contract layer reported by the issue.
